notes.title: The biggest update to date is now available for free! (27 levels added)
notes.content:
We have created 27 lovingly designed new levels for you, doubling the number of levels and the fun of Mr. Hibbl!

Have fun with this free update!

notes.title: Level intro and new languages
notes.content:
We have added information that will always let you know exactly what level you are in!

In addition, the languages ​​Chinese (simplified) and Turkish have been added!
